excerpts.author: sky.cactus
excerpts.content: I'm not attempting to "dunk" on anything.  I'm making the point that we are building censorship resistant software, and because of that people are free to do whatever they want on it, including things that are dangerous and risky.  We can try to do our best to advise against these behaviors, but we cannot stop them and often times market forces win out against our advise.  This doesn't change the fact that we are building censorship resistant software and will follow-through with that vision even if it means those people who didn't listen to us get hurt.  We would rather they didn't get hurt, but ultimately we cannot save them from themselves.
